references.text: The Israelites gathered at Mizpah, illustrating the pattern of the entire assembly convening to address serious matters.
The assembly at Mizpah reflects the same pattern of Israel gathering to deal with an issue threatening covenant unity.
Israel's idolatry at Baal-Peor explains why the tribes reacted so strongly to what they believed was idol worship.
Israel gathered for war against the Midianites, an example of holy war against those who led Israel into sin.
Shiloh was the place where the tabernacle stood, and thus the gathering place for all Israel's congregation.
The law concerning going to war against a city that has turned away from the Lord and worships other gods.
Achan's sin brought wrath upon all Israel, demonstrating why the tribes were concerned about shared responsibility.
